title: feat(lint): warn when a permission set's own View All / Modify All makes its field mask inert
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8W3xWg9UzvjKRfew8ju8Fz6)_

Fixes #29544
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@objectstack/lint` 新增一条 warning 规则 `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`。权限集在某对象上持有「查看全部」或「修改全部」，同一集合又对该对象的字段写了 `readable: false`（或在「修改全部」下的编辑锁）时，提示这个遮罩对持有人不生效，并给出改法。
- 为什么改：按 #29106 的裁决 A，超级用户位对该对象的每个字段都投 readable/editable 票，同集合的遮罩成了摆设；作者以为字段藏住了，其实没有，仓里已有两个测试夹具因此被修过。
- 风险与回滚：只是 warning，任何入口都不拒收（运行时发布门禁实测记为 advisory）。示例、showcase、平台默认权限集普查均为 0 条。回滚即还原本 PR，无迁移。
- 先看：`packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts` 中新规则段（紧挨 Modify All 删除段之前）与 `holdsSuperuserBypass` 副本；`packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validate-security-posture.test.ts -t inert`，预期 8 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的：无,席位落地

## What changes

After ruling A on #29106 (ruling of record 6573563853), a permission set that holds View All or Modify All on an object votes on every field of that object in both field merges (`superuserFieldVote` in `@objectstack/core`). So the same set's `readable: false` on that object hides the field from none of its holders, and under Modify All its edit lock (`editable: false`, or `editable` omitted, which parses to false) holds none of them back. The pair is legal, so nothing warned the author.

New rule id `security-superuser-field-mask-inert`, severity **warning**, pushed from `validateSecurityPosture`'s permission-set loop. That function is the existing `validateSecurityPosture` entry in `AUTHORING_RULES`, so the warning runs on `os lint`, `os validate`, `os build` and the runtime publish gate for a `permission` write (measured on the built `runtime.js`: `runRuntimeAuthoringRules({ type: 'permission', … })` returns it under `advisories`, `errors` empty).

- `viewAllRecords` beside `readable: false` → finding.
- `modifyAllRecords` beside `readable: false` or an edit lock → finding; one finding per entry, naming both when both are inert.
- `viewAllRecords` beside an edit lock → no finding (View All never widens a write, so the lock binds).
- One set at a time: another set's bypass also unmasks a holder of both sets, but no author wrote an inert entry there.

Example message: `viewAllRecords on objects.sys_user votes on every field of "sys_user", so readable: false on 'sys_user.email' binds none of this set's holders`. Hint: remove the bit and reach the rows with `readScope` / `writeScope` or a row-level policy, or delete the entry if the bypass is meant.

**The bypass reading.** `@objectstack/lint` depends on `@objectstack/spec` alone, so it cannot import core. `holdsSuperuserBypass` is copied verbatim into `validate-security-posture.ts` (the `objects[name] || objects['*']` lookup, `Boolean(...)` bits, Modify All implies View All) and exported from the lint barrel under the same name. `packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts` imports core's function and lint's copy and asserts they answer alike over a 410-case matrix (own entry × wildcard entry, each absent / null / empty / view / modify / both / false / truthy and falsy non-booleans, × object × bit, plus sets with no usable `objects`). The seat ruled this route (claim amendment 6593310531).

The entry's bits are read as parsing writes them: an omitted `readable` is `true`, an omitted `editable` is `false`. A raw set and its parse give the same answer (pinned).

Files (6, +402 / -1):

- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`: the id, the `holdsSuperuserBypass` copy, the arm, a header table row.
- `packages/lint/src/rule-explanations.ts`: the id's `os explain` entry.
- `packages/lint/src/index.ts`: exports the id and `holdsSuperuserBypass`.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts`: a new top-level `describe` (8 cases), plus the file's meta-guards: the id in `RULE_IDS`, a reachability-corpus fixture, push-site count 19 → 20, read surfaces `set` / `op` / `mask`, and `inertBits` under plumbing.
- `packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`: the parity pin (new file).
- `.changeset/29544-superuser-field-mask-inert.md`: patch for `@objectstack/lint`.

New public names: the rule id and the `holdsSuperuserBypass` export from `@objectstack/lint` (same name as core's on purpose: it is the same function).

## Why

The two repo fixtures the card names (`resume-decider-identity.integration.test.ts`, `explain-principal-person.test.ts`) went inert silently and were repaired by #29387. The composed sets in `admin-ledger-decision-metadata.dogfood.test.ts` are built from shared consts, so a grep for the pair does not find them. Reading the normalized set does.

## Tests

`validate-security-posture.test.ts`, new `describe` "a field mask its own set's View All / Modify All makes inert". Each case is a set parsed by `PermissionSetSchema` unless it says otherwise:

1. The resume-decider fixture before its repair (Modify All + `restricted_note` edit lock) → one warning.
2. The explain-principal-person fixture before its repair (View All + `email` read mask) → one warning.
3. The admin-ledger dogfood's composed sets, spelled from shared consts as that file does: `ald_withhold_set` and `ald_withhold_only_set` each fire once on `sys_user.email`; the `editable: false` grants beside View All and `ald_unmask_set` fire nothing.
4. Modify All + `readable: false` → warning; View All + edit lock → nothing.
5. Wildcard: `'*'` Modify All with no entry for the object → warning; `'*'` Modify All plus an explicit entry without the bit → nothing (lookup, not merge).
6. Unparsed `{ readable: true }` under Modify All → warning, and equal to the parsed set's answer.
7. Controls: the two fixtures as repaired (row policy + mask; org read/write depth + lock), and a bypass in one set beside a mask in another → nothing.
8. One-line message (≤ 200 chars) and hint, naming the bit and the entry; `explainRule` defined for the id.

Red first, on `61adbe57` (tests plus the id constant, no arm): 7 failed, 1 passed (the control case).

Parity: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`: 3/3.

Ablation of the parity pin (rule committed first; `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run under a restore trap): in lint's copy, the anchor `const op = (objects[objectName] || objects['*']) as` was replaced with the wildcard-first lookup (anchor 1 → 0, blob `df680307` → `37845e72`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint build`, then `node scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs @objectstack/lint 'objects["*"] || objects[objectName]' --source-marker=…`: marker in 4 built files, tree reading passed, exit 0. Parity test: 2 failed, 1 passed, with 60 diverging cases listed. Restored: blob equals HEAD `df680307`, `git diff HEAD` empty. After a rebuild, the preflight `--absent` check exited 0 (marker absent from all 20 built files, tree clean), and the parity test passed 3/3.

## Acceptance notes

- Census, run with the rule on built `dist/` over loaded modules: `examples/app-crm` 2 sets → 0; `examples/app-todo`, `examples/app-multi-package` 0 sets; the showcase (`examples/app-showcase/src/security/permission-sets.ts`) 9 sets, 2 with field entries → 0; the platform baseline (`plugin-security`'s `default-permission-sets.ts`) 9 sets, 6 with field entries → 0.
- Test fixtures can't be loaded outside vitest, so they were read by hand, not run. 24 files carry both a bypass bit and a field entry. Only the admin-ledger dogfood's two composed sets would fire (case 3). The two repaired fixtures are clean. The rest put the bit and the mask in different sets (`fls-superuser-vote*`, `explain-engine`), on different objects (`delete-reference-cleanup-system-identity`), or on a `'*'` entry without the bits (`security-plugin.test.ts`).
- Noted, not filed: by the same ruling, the admin-ledger dogfood's `withheld` and `wildcard` readers are not actually withheld `email`: their own set's View All on `sys_user` unbinds the mask. That file's header calls the View All "a row-scope grant, not a field one". The file still passes, because it asserts that no reader is served a subject row at all (deployment-level rows), so no assertion depends on the mask. It is not edited here, since the census does not force it. Carrier: none; the seat decides.
- A `when`-conditioned edit lock under Modify All is reported like any other lock, because the merge applies the super-user vote under every `when` verdict (plugin-security's explain report already calls such an entry superseded). The spec refuses `readable: false` beside `when`, so no conditioned read mask exists to judge.

## Verification

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

All on head `c20d3a56` (after the second `origin/main` merge, which auto-merged a sibling rule's lines in `index.ts` and `rule-explanations.ts`), after `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/core...' --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 192 passed (192); Tests 7942 passed (7942).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck: OK`, debt unchanged at 2 files / 6 errors).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`: 3/3.
- `packages/cli` typecheck: narrowed, and declared here. Its full `tsc` needs the 63-package build closure, so it is left to `TypeScript Type Check`. Locally, the new file alone compiled under `packages/cli/tsconfig.test.json`'s options (a scratch tsconfig extending it, `files` set to the one test, `--listFiles`): exit 0, the file in the program, both `core/dist/index.d.ts` and `lint/dist/index.d.ts` resolved.
- `test:repo` is not run locally (CI's `Test Core`): the diff touches no `repo`-project test.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates and lint</summary>

On head `c20d3a56`, `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 58 commands from the 6-path change set (the same 58 as on the first head). All 58 recorded `exit 0`, and `--ran` reconciled them: "58 derived, 58 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `pnpm lint`: exit 0 (outside the derivation).

On the first head, two had exited 3 (prerequisite not met): `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needed an unshallow clone (`git fetch --unshallow origin main`, then 48 cases pass), and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needed built `dist/`. On the final head it reports 115 require entry points across 70 packages load.

Among them: `check:cross-package-test-inputs` (31 packages read outside themselves, all declared), `check:test-source-alias`, `check:undeclared-dep-imports`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:issue-citations`, all exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No spec hunk.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
